page.overview:
Who is August?

was an underborne faerie wizard played by Taliesin Jaffe in Age of Umbra.

August is an anthropomorphic spider, an arachnid-like faerie of roughly human size, with grey skin, six insectoid eyes, and pincers. He wears fingerless gloves, a too-large old top hat, and a scarf wound around his neck, making his face rather hard to make out, but his mouth is wider than a human's, with small mandibles to either side. His long coat has been repaired many times but remains solid and looks decent (albeit faded); under it he hides two additional sets of arms, E1|03:44|Age of Umbra: Desperloch}} as well as moth wings from a still living moth that is somehow fused to his spine. He carries a rather large sewing needle at his side.

He is very curious, although somewhat sinister.

August and his family lived in the Screaming Forest, but eventually August was taken to the Hive, a buried temple with honey-filled catacombs E4|0:00:14|Age of Umbra: The Rampart and Beyond}} ruled by the Queen Mother. This monstrous entity gave missions to those around her and sometimes changed them if she thought it was interesting, so she attached a living moth to August's back after an incident in which he fell trying to reach an artifact in a cave. E6|7:17|Age of Umbra: The Unforgiving City}} He stayed as part of a team of treasure hunters, and one day, he discovered the statue that became Misty's body. When she had just awakened she needed a name, so August started calling her "Mystery", which eventually evolved into her current name. At some point, they both fled, displeasing the Queen Mother, and ended up in Desperloch a few months before .
